settings.heading: Description
settings.content:
The O’Donnell Moonshine Advent Calendar isn’t just a countdown to Christmas – it makes every day something to look forward to.
24 days of Moonshine surprises, all wrapped in our bold signature style.
The highlight? A brand-new 700ml flavour, plus 14 different minis and exclusive merch!
Worth over £170 – yours for just £119.

settings.heading: Our Loyalty Scheme - The Gang
settings.content: Join our loyalty scheme 'The Gang' here to earn points, receive some amazing rewards and gain early access to exciting new products!

settings.heading: The Perfect Serve
settings.content: Find ways to enjoy the Moonshine in our "How to drink section". You'll find a drink for every variety included in the calendar

settings.heading: Shipping
settings.content: Currently, our Advent Calendars are only available for pre-order, as we will only start shipping the Calendars from the end of September onwards. However, you can certainly combine your purchase with other items that will be sent to you directly.

settings.heading: Ingredients & Allergens
settings.content:
Our Advent calendar is not suitable for vegans (Gelatine). It also does include products which contain gluten, soy & mustard. No other allergens are present in the 2025 calendar.
For further information please contact us here.

settings.heading: Contents - *SPOILER ALERT*
settings.content:
Attention, only read on if you want to know what you can look forward to in the new Advent Calendar.

Spoilers ahead!
Contents:

  • 2x Limited O'Donnell Moonshine XMAS liqueur (700ml/20% vol)*
  • 22x O'Donnell Moonshine Liqueur (50ml/20% vol)
  • 8x O'Donnell Moonshine Liqueur (50ml/25% vol)
  • 10x Original O'Donnell Moonshine Merchandise
  • 2x O'Donnell Moonshine Fruit Gummies Moonshine Melts **
  • 2x O'Donnell Moonshine Winter BBQ
    Sauce ***
  • 2x Sweepstake with a
    voucher that will be worth at least a minimum £10 in the online shop **** 

*Contains beta-carotene (E160a) as a natural colouring agent

**O'Donnell Moonshine fruit gummies Moonshine Melts: 'Wild Berry' Fruit gummies with 10% fruit content made from fruit juice concentrate with 'Wild Berry' flavour.

Ingredients: Sugar, glucose syrup, gelatine, water, white grape juice concentrate, acid: citric acid; flavourings, white tea extract, colouring foodstuff concentrate (carrot), fruit sweetener from apple juice concentrate, apple juice concentrate, concentrated pear juice, concentrated apricot juice, glazing agent: carnauba wax. Best Before 01/08/2026

***O'Donnell Moonshine Winter BBQ Sauce 'Balsamic & Pomegranate' Ingredients: Sugar, 19%balsamic Vinegar of Modena (contains sulphites),
tomato paste, plum puree (plums, sugar, spices), fig mustard (50% candied figs {50% figs, sugar, glucose syrup}, sugar,
water, glucose, syrup, gelling agent: pectin, distilled vinegar, allyl mustard oil, pepper, salt}, onion, apple, soy sauce (soybeans, salt, sugar, wheat flour), apple cider vinegar, pear, 2.6%
pomegranate liqueur (20%ABV), distilled vinegar, orange juice, honey, spices,
salt. Best Before 05/05/2027

**** Chances of winning: £10 -> 95% / £20 -> 3.3% / £50 -> 1.2% / £100 ->0.5%

settings.text: This year, we’ve made your wishes come true once again and created what might just be the best advent calendar yet. Behind every door hides a true piece of O’Donnell spirit: carefully selected liqueurs, exclusive merch, and as the grand highlight, a brand-new 700ml flavour – available only in this calendar. An experience that stays with you day after day, makes your Advent truly special, and lets you dive deep into the unique world of O’Donnell Moonshine.

settings.heading: How many different flavours of Moonshine does the Advent Calendar contain?
Are the products included the same as in previous years?
settings.row_content: No, the content of the Advent Calendar is new but of course our best Moonshine flavours are back.

settings.heading: Is the calendar vegan?
settings.row_content: The liqueurs are vegan & free from allergens, however, one of the other products in the Advent Calendar is not vegan.

settings.heading: When will the Advent Calendars be delivered?
settings.row_content:
We aim to ship our calendars end of September, please look out for a dispatch email.
Please also note if you have order multiple items that are not pre-order these will be shipped as usual, separately from the advent calendar.

settings.heading: Why have I received a shipping confirmation?
settings.row_content: You will receive the confirmation email as usual confirming your order, but shipping will commence end of September.

settings.heading: Why is my Advent Calendar is not included in my delivery?
settings.row_content: If you have order other products alongside the Advent Calendar, these will be shipped as usual, separately from the Advent Calendar.

settings.heading: I ordered two calendars but did not receive the discount.
settings.row_content: As the Early Bird offer is already £40 off the original price, no further discounts can be applied to this bundle.

settings.heading: Can you ship the 2 calendars of the Early bird offer to two different addresses?
settings.row_content: No, both calendars have to sent to one UK address.
